text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's already December 25th. I join Meisho Doto to help with the preparations for a small get-together we're having.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hmm-hmm. ♪ Holiday… ♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: La-di-daa. ♪ Happy holidays! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto continues humming this odd little song. Eventually, we finish setting everything up.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm so happy. I can't wait to see everyone at the party!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: The me before coming to Tracen would never be spending time with good friends like this.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Why? Well, um… let's say I didn't have anyone I could call… a friend.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I couldn't make any, really. I've never lived long enough in the same place.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I would say my fondest holiday memory is probably the time I celebrated with my parents on an air shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That's right.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: We had to move around a lot for my dad's job.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I tried really hard to make friends, but I never really got to know anyone long enough to get invited to parties.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I kept on trying though! I tried, just…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: My mother and father saw how sad I was, so they quietly celebrated with me on the plane.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: There were only candied carrots to eat and juice to drink, but we still held hands and quietly sung carols together.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hmm-hmm. ♪ Holiday… ♪ La-di-daa. ♪ Happy holidays!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now I know the story behind her little song. Not only that…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is probably one of the reasons why Meisho Doto doesn't have much confidence. Everything she built always came tumbling down.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But that's all in the past! ♪ Right now, I have a lot of friends coming to celebrate.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I wonder when they'll be here. I just can't wait. I wrote on the invitation to come thirty minutes early, so it shouldn't be too long…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Aaaaahh! I forgot to send out the invitations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She screams in agony. Without receiving invitations, no one will know to come. That makes today…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ohhh… This is just like my past. The two of us alone, like I was with my family…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'll just sing my heart out! La, la, laa! Happy holidaaays!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ring, ring!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, someone's… here?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Darn tootin'! Is this where the party's supposed to happen? Sorry I'm tardy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I see you're runnin' this rodeo, Doto. Let's get the party started!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Whaaat? How did you get my invitation if I never sent it out?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's going on? Could it be I actually did hand them out?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Or did you hand them out for me, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I don't remember doing anything like that…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Invitation? I didn't receive no invitation. However…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I was passin' by when I got the sense a party was happenin' somewhere! And ya can't have a party without lots of people!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Turns out Taiki Shuttle decided to drop by on a hunch. But then…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. I heard this is where the animal lovers club was secretly hosting their special event tonight.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? Have I got the wrong place? Is this a holiday party or something?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll be. Pardon my intrusion.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Holy cow! Your timin' couldn't have been better, Nature! ☆ Join the celebration, won't ya?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huuh… are you sure that's okay? I feel a little out of place. Doto, is this your party?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, it is. You can stay and enjoy yourself if you'd like. No one else will be here anyway.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: We don't have many animals, but there is a tanuki.

text_block_list.name: Tanuki
text_block_list.text: Yip, yip!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto may not have had many friends in the past, but right now she has Taiki Shuttle and Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And a tanuki.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What are you all doing?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Ayabe… You came?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But… my invitations, they weren't sent out… How?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: We don't need a letter or permission to join in, do we?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Besides, a certain someone has a habit of barging in uninvited.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! Welcome all to my holiday party! I presume all the guests have already arrived.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Um, Opera O, this party was organized by Doto's fans.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch, I knew it would be cramped. That's why I told everyone to find somewhere bigger.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Cramped? Uh-oh, do you need to stretch your legs?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to running against you at the Arima Kinen. Also, thank you so much for hosting this gathering.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, wh-what's going on?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With all Meisho Doto's friends looking out for her, it seems we didn't have to worry about preparations after all.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Come, Doto, commence the festivities! Let us raise our glasses and sound a chorus of cheers to your many fans!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone, for doing something like this for someone like me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm slow, wimpy, and clumsy—I'm flawed in so many ways, but I couldn't be happier right now!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: So please, raise your glasses. And cheeers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sploosh!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waaagh! It spilled all over my head!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone laughs at what we all saw coming. With her surrounded by many fans, the merrymaking seems to go on forever.
